name: CeLAND
full_name: CeLAND artificial-source antineutrino experiment at KamLAND
summary: CeLAND proposed placing a compact cerium-144/praseodymium-144 antineutrino source near KamLAND to test eV-scale sterile-neutrino disappearance. It is archived as a historical source proposal, separate from normal KamLAND reactor observations.
detection_principle: Inverse beta decay in the KamLAND liquid scintillator would reconstruct event energy and distance from the source, seeking an oscillating spatial event distribution.

status.label: Historical proposal
status.evidence: The cited design is a proposal. Its planned 2015 source deployment is not treated as an achieved milestone.

collaboration.name: CeLAND Collaboration
collaboration.participants_note: Institutions listed here are selected documented participants; the official collaboration page provides the complete membership.

key_parameters.name: Baseline scale
key_parameters.value: Approximately 10 m or less, depending on source location

results.summary: The report presents projected disappearance sensitivity; no source-run observation is asserted.

media.caption: CeLAND source-deployment concept in the KamLAND detector; design illustration.
media.reuse_status: Copyright and any stated reuse conditions remain with the original source. Public access is not a reuse licence.
media.visual_review_note: Inspected final local figure and checked its apparatus identity and design/measurement stage against the public source.

sources.title: A. Gando et al., CeLAND: search for a 4th light neutrino state with a 3 PBq 144Ce-144Pr electron antineutrino generator in KamLAND
supports: Experimental identity, apparatus and scientific programme

uncertainties: A realized source-deployment campaign was not established from the reviewed primary sources.
